scope.objective: Assess whether local M-CSA/current702 mechanism evidence overlaps public CARD enzyme-mediated AMR families enough to justify a cross-domain transfer benchmark.

No edits to labels, registries, ontology files, production scoring, imports, or thresholds.
actions_performed: Read existing local graph, geometry, learned-retrieval, and current702 sequence artifacts.
Performed small public CARD metadata lookups only for AMR family naming and scope checks.

excluded_near_misses.reason_excluded: Beta-lactam biosynthesis-like chemistry, not beta-lactam antibiotic inactivation or an AMR enzyme family.
Public fosfomycin-related target enzyme, not a fosfomycin-inactivation enzyme such as CARD FosA/FosB/FosX/FosC families.
M-CSA mechanism text notes beta-lactamase-like similarity but lack of beta-lactamase activity; not an AMR positive.

criteria: At least three CARD-relevant enzyme families must have current702 positives with public sequence, selected structure, and active-site evidence.
At least two non-beta-lactamase AMR families should each have three or more current702 positives before claiming broad enzyme-only AMR scaling support.
M-CSA entries outside current702 do not count toward current benchmark positives without a separate authorized review/import path.
Current registry labels should support the mechanism axis directly or be explicitly treated as scout-only.

observed.public_sequence_structure_active_site_su: All 8 current702 likely positives have sequence coverage, selected PDB structures, and local active-site geometry evidence; 3 of 8 have current seed_fingerprint labels and 5 of 8 are current out_of_scope rows.
observed.diversity_limitation: Support is concentrated in beta-lactamases; aminoglycoside support has only one APH-like and one ANT-like row; CAT is M-CSA-only outside current702.

feasibility_gate.decision_rationale: The overlap is enough for a beta-lactamase-centric smoke panel and an AMR scout panel, but not enough for a real broad enzyme-only AMR cross-domain transfer benchmark.
